messages:
Nora: Quick sync 8:30am9: Capacity squeeze from infra. We need a short, defensible cut list for the May milestone to avoid a ship slip.
Eli: What are hard must-haves for the launch?
Nora: Core text generation, chat mode, embeddings API, promptstore. Everything else is negotiable.
Priya: Customer signals: 2 pilot customers need tenant-scoped model pinning and audit exports. Several smaller customers care about per-route analytics retention.
Ben: Eng constraints: model-pinning adds stateful routing complexity and needs a DB migration. ETA is 3 weeks. Analytics retention bump is mostly config + storage estimate, ~4 engineers x 1 week.
Nora: Option A: keep model-pinning, cut non-essential analytics and dynamic routing; slip by 2 weeks. Option B: keep ship date, cut model-pinning and offer concierge migration for pilots; keep analytics as-is.
Eli: Finance prefers no slip. They can fund a short-term storage bump but not an extra sprint.
Priya: For pilot customers we can offer concierge model-pinning on Hosted: manual pinning + contractual SLA credits. That's doable if Sales secures a LOI.
Ben: Technical risk: concierge model-pinning will be manual and fragile; need an ops runbook and monitoring. Also add a kill-switch if the pinned routing causes latency spikes.
QA-Bot: Suggested release checks: smoke-gen, pinned-routing sanity, audit-export integrity, p99 latency under 2s.
Nora: Proposed decision: Ship on time (May) with cuts: remove dynamic routing by cost-tier, defer extended analytics retention to v1, move tenant-model-pinning to v1 except by concierge pilot. Keep embeddings and promptstore.
Eli: Add mitigation: implement an emergency feature-flag path for model-pinning so we can toggle if pilot demand spikes.
Priya: I'll tell Sales to offer concierge pilots with SLA credit and request LOIs from the two marquee customers.
Ben: I'll scope the feature-flag + kill-switch and draft the ops runbook (48h).
Nora: Action items:
- Priya: customer LOIs + pilot terms (48h)
- Ben: feature-flag + kill-switch + runbook (48h)
- Eli: update milestone tracker and stakeholder note (EOD)
- QA-Bot: run the suggested release checks once PRs are merged (automated)
Priya: If LOIs come in and we can fund a small Dedicated slot, we can convert concierge to a short-lived dedicated canary.
Ben: Noted. I'll include the cost delta in the runbook.
Nora: Recording: Decision made to prioritize on-time ship. Cuts = dynamic routing deferred, analytics retention bumped to v1, tenant model-pinning concierge-only for pilots. Will update release metadata and communicate to customers.
Eli: 44d
Priya: posting pilot terms to #customer-success now.
Nora: Thanks everyone. We'll reassess if LOIs or infra timelines change.
